name: Argan Oil
description: Argan oil is a natural, cold-pressed extract from the kernels of the argan tree (Argania spinosa), native to Morocco. It is known for its rich content in vitamins A, E, and fatty acids which contribute to its moisturizing and restorative properties.
best_for: Thinning hair or hair loss concerns
avoid_for: Individuals with known allergies to argan oil or similar oils
Those on medications that cause photosensitivity (seek medical advice)
how_to_use: Apply a small amount directly onto the skin and massage in gently for face or body care
Use as a leave-on treatment after shaving or exfoliation to soothe and moisturize
Warm a few drops in palms, then apply to hair from roots to ends for detangling and conditioning
Can be used as a finishing touch on styled hair to add shine and control
possible_side_effects: Allergic reactions such as itching or rash (rare)
Photosensitivity may occur; use caution when applying directly to skin before sun exposure
scientific_evidence: Research supports argan oil's antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, contributing to its effectiveness in skin care. Studies also suggest its potential benefits for promoting hair health.
